This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the “Agreement”) is made effective as of July 24, 2023 (“Effective Date”), by and between 273 Ventures, LLC, a Michigan limited liability company (the “273 Ventures”) and Acme Co., a Nevada corporation (the “Counterparty”).
</untrusted_document_content>

<untrusted_document_content finding_id="22c1eea7a82a">
Each party is herein referred to individually as a “Party,” or collectively as the “Parties”.
</untrusted_document_content>

<untrusted_document_content finding_id="1ab10bb78f8e">
In connection with the disclosure of the Company’s Confidential Information to the Counterparty, the Party furnishing Confidential information is the “Discloser” or “Disclosing Party” and the Party receiving the Confidential Information is the “Recipient” or “Receiving Party.”
</untrusted_document_content>

<untrusted_document_content finding_id="0f0a07de9ca7">
In consideration of the Parties’ discussions and access the Receiving Party may have to Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party, the Parties agree that the Receiving Party will protect the Confidential Information and material which may be disclosed between the Disclosing Party and the Recipient.
</untrusted_document_content>

<untrusted_document_content finding_id="0fbc497f5dab">
Therefore, the Parties hereby agree as follows:
</untrusted_document_content>

<untrusted_document_content finding_id="8aa4f505ba6e">
CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION.
</untrusted_document_content>

<untrusted_document_content finding_id="d27dc56f4a28">
The term "Confidential Information" means any information or material which is proprietary to the Disclosing Party, whether or not owned or developed by the Disclosing Party, which is not generally known other than by the Disclosing Party, and which the Recipient may obtain through any direct or indirect contact with the Disclosing Party.
</untrusted_document_content>

<untrusted_document_content finding_id="118b0f9eb66f">
Regardless of whether specifically identified as confidential or proprietary, Confidential Information shall include any information provided by the Disclosing Party concerning the legal, business, or technology and information of the Disclosing Party and of any third party with which the Disclosing Party deals.
</untrusted_document_content>

<untrusted_document_content finding_id="147a6b99e8c3">
This includes any information that a reasonable person would understand it to be confidential, and includes, but is not limited to, the following:
</untrusted_document_content>

<untrusted_document_content finding_id="7db054b97a43">
business records and plans
</untrusted_document_content>
